de: Jede der drei if-Anweisungen wird zu einem Attribut vor ihrem Parameter. Danach baut der Rumpf nur noch das Objekt.
en: Each of the three if statements becomes one attribute in front of its parameter. After that the body only builds the object.
Empty check: [Parameter(Mandatory)]. Between check: [ValidateRange(30, 365)]. One-of check: [ValidateSet('Report', 'Disable')].

[CmdletBinding()] param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [ValidateRange(30, 365)][int]$Days = 90, [ValidateSet('Report', 'Disable')][string]$Mode = 'Report') and only the [pscustomobject] in the body
